title: Hard crash on renaming PyQt4.QtCore.pyqtSlot (pylint 1.3.0, astroid 1.2.0)
body:
Originally reported by: **Antony Lee (BitBucket: [anntzer](http://bitbucket.org/anntzer), GitHub: @anntzer?)**

---

Consider the following snippet:

```
#!python
from PyQt4.QtCore import *

Slot = pyqtSlot

class Obj(QObject):
    @Slot()
    def slot(self):
        pass
```

(in fact, the renaming of pyqtSlot to Slot happens in a helper module, to hide the differences between PyQt4 and PySide).

Pylinting this leads to a hard crash:

```

    load_entry_point('pylint==1.3.0', 'console_scripts', 'pylint')()

    Run(sys.argv[1:])

    linter.check(args)
```
